title: Jubilant Dutch Vegetable Casserole
description: A floral and velvety Dutch dish featuring cornstarch and bhuna, perfect for a romantic evening, this vegetarian-friendly casserole is a delight to the senses. It combines the richness of vegetables and spices to create a truly unique taste experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until it is translucent.
Add the sliced carrots and cubed potatoes to the pan, cooking for 10 minutes or until they are slightly tender.
In a small bowl, mix the bhuna spice mix with the cornstarch, then add the mixture to the pan and stir well.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a simmer, cooking for 5 minutes or until the liquid has thickened.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with chopped fresh parsley.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25 minutes or until it is hot and the vegetables are tender.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
